name: kagent agent
description: A kagent declarative agent in the tenant's namespace, answering with one of the tenant's model deployments through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The model base URL is <API URL>/v1/deployments/<deployment id>.

templates:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-model
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  OPENAI_API_KEY: {{ .Values.model.apiKey | default "unused" | quote }}
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1alpha2
kind: ModelConfig
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  provider: OpenAI
  model: {{ required "model.name is required" .Values.model.name | quote }}
  apiKeySecret: {{ .Release.Name }}-model
  apiKeySecretKey: OPENAI_API_KEY
  openAI:
    baseUrl: {{ required "model.baseUrl is required" .Values.model.baseUrl | quote }}
apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1alpha2
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  type: Declarative
  description: {{ .Values.agent.description | default "A kagent agent" | quote }}
  declarative:
    runtime: go
    modelConfig: {{ .Release.Name }}
    systemMessage: {{ .Values.agent.systemMessage | default "You are a helpful assistant." | toJson }}
    deployment:
      podSecurityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      securityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        capabilities:
          drop:
            - ALL

baseUrl.title: Endpoint
baseUrl.description: Your model deployment through the metered chat proxy: <API URL>/v1/deployments/<deployment id> (model pods admit only metering points)

name.title: Model name
name.description: The model name the deployment serves

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Only when the endpoint asks for one
